connector.name: Airweave Search
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for searching Airweave collections with natural language queries.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.airweave.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package airweave-mcp-search. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the airweave-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Collection-Readable-ID
headers.description: The Airweave collection readable ID to search

env.name: AIRWEAVE_API_KEY
env.description: Your Airweave API key for authentication

env.name: AIRWEAVE_BASE_URL
env.description: Airweave API base URL (defaults to https://api.airweave.ai)
